caption:
VEGAN Mocha Delight Frappe
this recipe is dark, strong and delicious
5 minute recipe | vegan 
C: 42 | F: 5 | P: 4
Calories: 205 per serve
Makes 1 glass

Ingredients
1 banana, frozen, cut into chunks
1 cup brewed coffee, chilled
1 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder
1-2 sachets, monk fruit
1 tbsp chia, soaked in 2 tbsp water for 10 minutes before blending
4-5 ice cubes
for topping: vegan chocolate chips / shavings + biscuit crumbs 

Method
blend all the ingredients together and top with vegan chocolate and vegan shortbread crumbs
